question: Does an imagined supportless universe fall downward?
premises: The universe rests in its own support-power.
inference: An imagined supportless universe does not fall because it rests in its own support-power.
uncertainties: "svādhāraśaktau" may mean "in the power of its own support" rather than "in own support-power"; "viśvamitthaṃ" may mean "the universe thus".
plain_english: Even supportless, the imagined does not indeed fall downward; thus the universe, rested in its own support-power, let be considered.
